Widths.note: The three widths are now visibly different thanks to the 1600px capture viewport — default 1400px, narrow at reading measure, wide edge to edge. Below 832px they were identical, which is why the override exists.

Insets.note: Paper runs edge to edge, the block starts where the container padding ends, and the copy states the actual values.

NarrowForReading.note: Real long-form at reading measure: label, statement heading, lead and body. Text-heavy, so it also proves Inter and the type scale are applied.
